column1: # Symbol CRCs demanded by the stock Motorola Razr Fold vendor_dlkm modules.
# Extracted from the __versions section of all 328 modules of MMI-W3WB36.36-48-5.
# A module loads only if a provider exports the symbol with exactly this CRC, so every
# row whose provider is 'vmlinux' is a hard constraint on the kernel we build.
# provider: vmlinux = the stock kernel exports it
#           module  = another vendor module exports it
#           unknown = neither (the stock kernel lacks it too, so not a regression)
